Executive Velocity: 2023 BMW X7 M60i xDrive
Experience the definitive "Ultimate Driving Machine" in its most expansive form. The 2023 BMW X7 M60i marked a major evolution for the flagship SAV (Sport Activity Vehicle), debuting a bold new split-headlight design and a modernized cockpit. Finished in a sophisticated Gray Metallic with a Black Leather interior, this Clean CARFAX M Performance model replaces the previous M50i with more tech, more aggression, and a brand-new electrified V8 heart.

The S68 V8: Electrified M Performance
The M60i debuted the all-new S68 engine, a 4.4L BMW M TwinPower Turbo V8 that integrates 48V mild-hybrid technology for the first time.

Symphonic Power: Delivers a robust 523 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque, resulting in a 060 mph sprint in as little as 3.8 to 4.5 seconds (depending on testing conditions).

Mild-Hybrid Precision: The 48V system includes an electric motor integrated into the 8-speed Steptronic Sport transmission, providing an extra 147 lb-ft of torque for instant throttle response and smoother stop-start transitions.

M-Specific Chassis: Standard equipment includes Integral Active Steering (rear-wheel steering) and Active Roll Stabilization, allowing this full-size luxury cruiser to handle with the agility of a much smaller sport sedan.

M Sport Exhaust: Features an active flap system that delivers a deep, authoritative V8 growl that intensifies in Sport and Sport+ modes.

M Sport Professional & Stealth Aesthetics
This X7 is equipped with the M Sport Professional Package, giving it a darkened, high-performance "Shadowline" look that perfectly complements the Gray Metallic paint.

Extended Shadowline Trim: Replaces traditional chrome with high-gloss black accents on the kidney grille, roof rails, and window surrounds.

M Sport Brakes with Black Calipers: Provides massive stopping power with a stealthy, understated aesthetic hidden behind the large alloy wheels.

Illuminated Kidney Grille: The iconic BMW "Iconic Glow" grille features cascading LED lighting that accentuates the front end at night.

Aerodynamic M Mirrors: Features the twin-stalk mirror design previously reserved only for full "M" models like the X5 M.

The Digital Command Center
The 2023 refresh introduced the BMW Curved Display, completely transforming the interior into a minimalist, high-tech sanctuary.

iDrive 8 Operating System: A seamless, single piece of glass houses a 12.3-inch Digital Instrument Cluster and a massive 14.9-inch Central Information Display, featuring BMW Maps with Augmented View.

Heads-Up Display (HUD): Projects vital speed, navigation, and driver-assist data directly onto the windshield, keeping your focus on the road ahead.

Harman Kardon Surround Sound: A premium 16-speaker system specifically tuned for the X7s expansive cabin, providing a rich, immersive acoustic experience.

Executive Comfort: Includes Heated and Ventilated Front Seats, Heated Rear Seats, and a Panoramic Moonroof that floods all three rows with natural light.

The Covert Commitment
Serving Central Texas and beyond since 1909, the Covert family has spent over a century building a legacy of trust and excellence. Visit us at 11750 Research Blvd, Austin, TX to experience the "Covert Commitment" firsthand and see why this V8-powered X7 M60i is the ultimate luxury family transporter.

Discover the epitome of luxury and performance with the 2024 Lincoln Aviator Black Label. This stunning SUV is a true testament to Lincoln's commitment to crafting exceptional vehicles that cater to the discerning tastes of the modern driver.

Adorned in a captivating Pristine White Metallic Tri-Coat, this Aviator Black Label is a sight to behold. Boasting a suite of premium features, it includes:

- Black Exterior Elements
- Black Painted Roof
- Body-Color Exterior Elements

Step inside and be enveloped in the unparalleled comfort of the Savannah Leather Heated/Ventilated Seats, accompanied by the state-of-the-art SYNC 3 Communication & Entertainment System and a remarkable 28-speaker Revel Ultima 3D Audio System. The Panoramic Vista Roof and power liftgate add to the Aviator's exceptional versatility, while the adaptive suspension and 4-Wheel Disc Brakes ensure a smooth and confident driving experience.

Powered by a potent 3.0L V6 engine paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission and All-Wheel Drive, this Aviator delivers exceptional performance and efficiency, with an EPA-estimated 17 MPG in the city and 24 MPG on the highway.

Elevate your driving experience with the advanced driver-assistance technologies, including Lane Departure Warning System, Auto High-beam Headlights, and the Emergency Communication System, providing you with the peace of mind you deserve.

Designed to cater to the discerning tastes of the modern luxury SUV buyer, the 2024 Lincoln Aviator Black Label is a true masterpiece of engineering and craftsmanship. Experience the unparalleled combination of style, comfort, and performance that only a Lincoln can provide.

We invite you to visit our showroom and take this exceptional vehicle for a test drive. Discover the true essence of luxury and let the 2024 Lincoln Aviator Black Label redefine your driving experience.

description:
The 2016 BMW X6 xDrive35i is a premium sport activity vehicle that blends SUV capability with a coupe-like silhouette.
It features a bold and aggressive exterior design, highlighted by its sloping roofline and muscular stance.
Under the hood, it is powered by a 3.0-liter turbocharged inline-6 engine that produces 300 horsepower.
The xDrive all-wheel-drive system provides excellent traction and stability in various driving conditions.
Acceleration is quick for its class, going from 0 to 60 mph in just under 6 seconds.
The interior reflects the luxury standards of BMW, with high-quality materials and a driver-focused layout.
Seating is comfortable and supportive, though rear headroom is slightly limited due to the coupe-style roof.
The cabin includes premium features such as leather upholstery, a panoramic sunroof, and dual-zone climate control.
Its iDrive infotainment system offers a user-friendly interface with a central display and rotary controller.
Standard technology includes navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, and a premium sound system.
Safety features include stability control, multiple airbags, and available driver assistance systems like blind-spot monitoring.
Cargo space is adequate but less practical than traditional SUVs because of the sloping rear design.
The ride quality balances sportiness with comfort, making it suitable for both daily driving and long trips.
Handling is sharp and responsive, giving it a more car-like feel than many SUVs.
Overall, the 2016 BMW X6 xDrive35i stands out as a stylish and performance-oriented luxury crossover.
